caption:
The other night, I had dinner with a friend
who works as a hairstylist in Singapore.

We share the same salon,
yet our work and our days are not the same.
Listening to what she has been thinking about
was a quiet pleasure —
the kind of conversation that leaves you
with more ideas than you came with.

There are not many of us,
Japanese people working far from Japan.
But there are more than you might imagine,
each one working hard in their own way.

I left inspired,
and grateful for a very good evening.
